data.description: The Ski Trainer copies the movement of cross-country skiing. The user stands on two orange footplates, holds the handles and slides the legs forward and back in opposite directions while the arms push and pull. It works the legs, arms and core together and raises the heart rate without any impact on the joints. It suits regular walkers and joggers who want a harder cardio station in a park, and it is popular in college and corporate open gyms. The Ski Trainer is finished in Play Orange as part of our Fun Fitness range. The measured drawing and warranty terms are sent with each quote. We will confirm cover in your quote, based on our standard terms of 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings.

items.pText: The Ski Trainer copies the movement of cross-country skiing. The user stands on two orange footplates, holds the handles and slides the legs forward and back in opposite directions while the arms push and pull. It works the legs, arms and core together and raises the heart rate without any impact on the joints. It suits regular walkers and joggers who want a harder cardio station in a park, and it is popular in college and corporate open gyms. The Ski Trainer is finished in Play Orange as part of our Fun Fitness range. The measured drawing and warranty terms are sent with each quote. We will confirm cover in your quote, based on our standard terms of 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings.

Both footplate arms swing on bearings, which take steady wear on a busy track. Check and grease them on a set schedule. The Ski Trainer is installed self-standing or grouted after we see your ground. Leave space in front of and behind the footplates for the full stride.
